> 第19章 神秘的蛋（第1页）
大佬，你买这么贵的东西知道是什么？别人也不知道，我想知道是啥啊？
那些傻憨憨，知道啥？不过我可以告诉你!这东西千年难求。天生地养墨宝，千年难形成，还要看机缘，运气。
这对修炼者来说，没什么用，但是用于书画的来说珍贵无比。画一幅画里面诞生器灵，没有境界限制，而器灵会随主人的实力变强而变强。
你说珍贵不？简直珍贵无比，等我吸收完墨宝，我再也不用继续沉睡了。
器灵大佬这么说，李天知道了墨宝的珍贵性，这可不是单单八千金币就能买到的，这是赚大发了。
药材之类的李天买了不少，自己是炼丹师，肯定得用到药材炼丹。
就在这时，小月主持人声音响了起来，接下来拍卖压轴东西。起拍价一万金币，每次加价不得少于五千。
小月介绍道，这是一颗火属性蛋，具体什么妖兽，不知道，但绝对物有所值。
比如炼丹师，如果买回去炼化这颗蛋，演化成妖火，炼丹是不是事半功倍。
大家都知道炼丹必须要有火，还有炉鼎。而这颗蛋刚好可以相辅相成，炼化成功的话。
众人一听起拍价都那么贵？然后经介绍那么详细，顿时来了精神。眼睛直溜溜的看着台上一个宝物盒，打开竟然是个蛋，散发着丝丝热量。
拍卖台下众人也是一阵火热，炼丹师少。但是总有会炼丹的，奈何腰包不足。只有少部分人可以购买，但是前提是贵宾间里的人会不会竞争。如果竞争那一点希望没有!
就这样有人开口了，一万五千金币。
一号包间三皇子比比嘴，悠闲的喝着茶。
上来就是加了一万金币，这让下面的有心想竞价的人心虚了。
五万三号包间，一个灰袍老者开口。
六万，一对年轻少女开口，四号包间。
李天也是无语了，这金币那么不值钱。一下子六万。还好自己现在身上还有一百多万。购买各种材料和墨宝花费了五十万，还有一百七十万。

小子别想多了，天书大佬开口道。这蛋很好，他们眼界低看不出什么来!赶紧拿下吧!别犹豫。
这四万加的台下的人心虚，这真的是财大气粗。
十五万，火神子开口，这火属性对他们来说很重要，本身就是修炼火系功法的。
二十万，三皇子开口。自己得拿回去研究研究，对于这颗蛋他也很有兴趣。
兄台我多出五万能否把这颗蛋让给我？我乃火神宗神子，兄台割爱我火神子感激不尽。
哟原来是火神宗，我皇室难道还差那点钱吗？兄台让给我，我出五十万。
听着他们自报家门，台下人知道了贵宾室里的人可能身份都不一般，没想到这么不一般。
两人听着李天说的话，你觉得能带出去吗？出了天商阁？
威胁的话不用说，两位，要是怕我就不会和你们竞争了？
两人狠狠的说道，那走着瞧。然后不再开口!。

The latest chapter of The Great Emperor_Chapter 19 The Mysterious Egg Page 1_How long can the Great Emperor go in the future_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 19 The Mysterious Egg (Page 1)
Boss, do you know why you bought such an expensive thing? No one else knows, I want to know what it is?
What do those silly fools know? But I can tell you! This thing is hard to find in a thousand years. It takes a thousand years to develop calligraphy treasures that are born with nature. It depends on chance and luck.
This is of little use to practitioners, but it is extremely valuable for use in calligraphy and painting. There is no limit to the realm of the weapon spirit that is born in a painting, and the weapon spirit will become stronger as the master's strength becomes stronger.
Would you say it is precious? It is simply extremely precious. Once I finish absorbing the Mo Bao, I will no longer have to continue sleeping.
The boss of Qi Ling said this, and Li Tian knew the preciousness of calligraphy treasures. This could not be bought with just eight thousand gold coins. This was a huge profit.
Li Tian bought a lot of medicinal materials. As an alchemist, he must use medicinal materials to make elixirs.
At this moment, host Xiaoyue's voice rang out, and the final item was auctioned next. The starting price is 10,000 gold coins, and each bid increase must not be less than 5,000 gold coins.
Xiaoyue introduced that this is a fire attribute egg. I don’t know what kind of monster it is, but it is definitely worth the money.
For example, if an alchemist buys and refines this egg and turns it into a demonic fire, will the alchemy be done with twice the result with half the effort?
Everyone knows that making alchemy requires fire and a furnace. And this egg can just complement each other, if the refining is successful.
When everyone heard that the auction price was so expensive? Then after being introduced in such detail, I immediately became energetic. He stared straight at a treasure box on the table. When he opened it, he found an egg, emitting the slightest trace of heat.
Everyone under the auction stage was also excited, including the alchemist. But there are always people who can make elixirs, but they don’t have enough money. Only a small number of people can buy it, but the premise is that the people in the VIP room will not compete. If there is competition, then there is no hope!
Just like that, someone said, fifteen thousand gold coins.
In Private Room No. 1, the third prince licked his lips and drank tea leisurely.
The first step was to add 10,000 gold coins, which made the people below who wanted to bid feel guilty.
In private room No. 53, an old man in gray robe spoke.
Sixty thousand, a pair of young girls asked, private room No. 4.
Li Tian was also speechless. This gold coin was so worthless. Sixty thousand at once. Fortunately, I still have more than one million with me. It cost 500,000 yuan to purchase various materials and calligraphy treasures, and another 1.7 million yuan.
Don't think too much, kid, the man from Heavenly Book said. This egg is very good. They have low vision and can't see anything! Get it quickly! Don't hesitate.
The people in the audience with these 40,000 yuan are really guilty. This is really a wealthy person.
One hundred and fifty thousand, the Fire God Son said, this fire attribute is very important to them, and they themselves practice fire-based skills.
Two hundred thousand, the third prince said. He had to take it back and study it. He was also very interested in this egg.
Brother, if I have an extra 50,000 yuan, can you give me this egg? I am the divine son of the Fire God Sect. My brother, I am deeply grateful for your love for me.
Oh, it turns out to be the Fire God Sect. Does my royal family still lack that little money? Brother, give it to me and I will pay you 500,000 yuan.
Listening to them announcing their homes, people in the audience knew that the people in the VIP room might have unusual identities, but they didn't expect them to be so unusual.
After listening to what Li Tian said, the two of them do you think they can be taken out? Out of Tianshang Pavilion?
Needless to say threats, you two, if you were afraid of me, you wouldn’t compete with you?
The two said fiercely, let's see. Then don’t speak again!.
